finalText:
**Redis lost, queue backed up, service died at 02:31.**

At `02:14:07.113Z` Redis connection was refused (`10.0.0.12:6379`). Cache fell back to direct store reads, causing miss storms and 5000ms timeouts across `api`, `worker-1`, `worker-2`, `scheduler`.

Reconnect attempts failed 12 times over 17 minutes, retrying every ~100 seconds. Queue depth climbed the whole time, from 52 to 568, past the 500 max.

At `02:31:44.902Z` `worker-2` hit an out of memory crash from the backlog. Supervisor restarted it, but at `02:31:52.318Z` `api` went unresponsive and the whole process group was killed. Service down.

Root cause is the Redis host at `10.0.0.12` going unreachable, with no circuit breaker to shed load once it did. Next step is checking why Redis dropped and adding backpressure so a cache outage can't cascade into an OOM crash.
